summary: Documented the kind-is-type model (stages 0-6) and the three locked-core additions the auditor named, in Documentation/v0.2/type-system.md, with the stale sections it supersedes annotated. Retired the orphaned separator golden block in type-reference-generation.md (decision 830). Edits are Documentation/v0.2/ only — no os/system teaching touched, so the teaching-edit rule does not trigger and no re-pins are needed. No production C# edited. DO NOT MERGE: held for Ingi's go, relayed by the host.

changes.description: New authoritative section 'A kind is a type (kind-is-type, 2026-10)': kind<T> : kind : type under its parent (type/kind/this.cs:20, this.Generic.cs:16); a kind is its parent except where it says otherwise (the one seam in kind<T>); names unique per level, no app-wide kind-by-name search, MIME/extension stay app-wide; written form {name, kind} nests; the name<kind> face (type/this.cs:571); [Kinds] stays on value-subclass parents; named values aren't kinds; separator is text's kind; a format owns its bytes until first use, json parses once into a plang dict/list via data.Open() (data/this.cs:322, json/this.cs:73-80); settings as their own top-level types read back by their type (789/796), no reader for an old stored shape (790, loud SettingsUnreadable 799); and the three locked-core adds OwnInternal (831, type/this.cs:736), file.read's Type slot (832, read.cs:21), the name<kind> face (834).

Callout at the top of 'Typed values' (superseded in part — a kind is a type now, not a loose .pr refinement; the per-format renderer table still describes the serializer layer; {name, kind} and int/decimal-are-kinds-of-number still hold).

Callout at the top of 'Strict kind': strict's probe moves onto the format kind (786); the kind/strict x4 suite is CARRIED, still red at merge (auditor F-SC-1), same reds on runtime2 so not a regression; the interface shapes shown are the prior model, re-verify before relying.

Callout at the top of 'Reader registry': the (type, kind)-keyed registry with runtime Register still stands; type is a plang type not a shape word ({item, kind: json}, not (object, json)); json parses into a plang dict/list on first read; a type with no reader reads its record and asks its item to make itself (ICreate.Create), which is how settings read back (789/796); no reader for an old stored shape (790).

Replaced the orphaned 'Golden output - separator' block with a retirement note (decision 830): separator is now a kind of text ({text, kind: separator}); TheSeparatorPage golden was retired; the former literal is in git history.
Added the index pointer for the new 'A kind is a type (kind-is-type, 2026-10)' section -> type-system.md.

verified_in_source: kind<T> : kind : type, where T : app.type.item.@this; the parent-forward seam, Family = parent (PLang/app/type/kind/this.Generic.cs:16-22,37)
OwnInternal hook (type/this.cs:652) and getter OwnInternal ?? kind.OwnInternal ?? Family._internal (type/this.cs:736)
file.read Type slot: data.@this<app.type.@this>? Type (module/file/read.cs:21); none=extension decides, given=declared type births from bytes (read.cs:23-61)
json parses once into a plang value, no JsonElement/navigator (type/item/kind/json/this.cs:8-9,73-80); data.Open() the parse-once door (data/this.cs:322)
separator is text's kind, a text subclass with its own open named-value set (type/item/separator/this.cs:10,12-15,28)
